javax.microedition.theme
Interface FontElement

All Superinterfaces:
Element
public interface FontElement
extends Element

Represents a customizable element that describes a font.

The implementation may use any presentation hints found in the element to determine the font technology to use.

Mapping between font attributes in a FontElement is implementation specific. Instances of FontElement are not intended to contain other data besides the name, style and size attributes, so the getContent method typically returns null. An implementation-specific font object may be returned.

getStyle

int getStyle()

Gets the font style. The style is an integer representing a logical OR of the styles plain, bold, italic and underline.

The implementation must use the same constant values as the MIDP 2.0 specification (see [MIDP2]). MIDP applications can use the symbolic constants defined in MIDP 2.0.

Returns:
the style
See Also:
